ai_summary: Ddev Plastiks Industries Limited announced the immediate resignation of Mrs. Ramya Hariharan, an Independent Director, effective July 27, 2026, citing professional preoccupations. Her departure necessitates a replacement to maintain critical oversight functions, as she also ceased membership in the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee. While the company stated there were no other material reasons for her resignation, the sudden loss of an independent director on key committees can subtly impact corporate governance and board composition.
